title: Three headline numbers (9:16)
description: A 13-second vertical stat reveal: a heading and source line frame three headline numbers, each landing as the hero of its own beat with an odometer digit roll, a gauge ring that fills only for percentages, and its label rising in; a recap sets all three side by side. Code-rendered (scene.stat-reveal) with a procedural pulse bed, a riser under each count, a soft impact as each number lands and a whoosh on each exit.

stat_1_label.description: The words right after the first number in the brief, copied exactly: in '98% of orders shipped the same day' it is 'of orders shipped the same day'

stat_1_prefix.description: Currency sign before the first number ($, £, €) when the brief writes one; empty for none

stat_1_unit.description: Unit after the first number as the brief writes it: %, M (million), bn, k, +, x, km; empty for none

copy_examples.brief: Vertical impact video for Riverside Food Bank. Our 2025 numbers: 1.2 million meals served, 86% of donations handed out within a week, and 12,400 volunteer shifts worked. Source: Riverside Food Bank annual report 2025. Warm look.

inputs.title: Riverside Food Bank in 2025
inputs.stat_2_label: of donations handed out within a week

copy_examples.note: Every number, unit and label is copied from the brief in its order; 1.2 million becomes 1.2 with the unit M and 12,400 becomes 12400; each label is the words right after its number. The heading names who and when without adding a claim, and the source is the brief's own wording.

style.typography: Inter ExtraBold numbers with small units, SemiBold labels

direction.action: Heading, then three numbers one per beat (count, meter, label), then a recap of all three

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/stat-reveal) rendered frame-exactly on a virtual clock; the content model supplies the heading and copies numbers, units, labels and the source from the brief.
Every number, unit, label and the source are VERBATIM: a writer may only copy them from the brief. Numbers must be numbers the brief states.
The gauge ring fills only for a % unit (a share of 100); other numbers get a neutral ring, so the meter never implies a proportion the data does not have.
Copy is fitted with measured glyphs; labels are capped at 44 characters and the heading at 40 by the recipe schema, and the render fails rather than overflow.

Beats at 13 s: numbers enter at 0.90, 3.98, 7.06 s and land at 2.39, 5.47, 8.55 s; the recap starts at 10.14 s. Risers end and impacts hit on the landings; whooshes sit on the exits at 3.58, 6.66, 9.69 s.

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -14 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
A reviewer checks every number, unit and label against the cited source, including that each label describes its own number.
A reviewer confirms the heading makes no claim beyond the numbers and the brand approves publication.
